$comment: Validate manifest (task 064, DR-24). The DECLARED steps of `npm run validate`.
Why this file exists. `validate` used to be an `&&` chain written inline in
package.json. Measured on the integration tip on 2026-08-07: step 1 exited 1,
so 8 of the 9 declared steps NEVER RAN — and the chain reported exactly one
line of failure, indistinguishable to a reader from 'one gate is red and the
rest are fine'. That is #1711's skipped-as-passed failure, one layer above CI.
The chain is now an aggregating runner (tools/audit/gates/run-validate.mjs) that
executes EVERY step regardless of earlier outcomes and reports each one. The
runner also asserts `executed === declared`, and the declared count is
`steps.length` READ FROM HERE — never a hard-coded integer, because a
hard-coded count is the same defect one level up: it drifts the moment
someone appends a step and reads green while doing it.
Adding a gate to `validate` means adding an entry here. `command` + `args`
are exec'd directly — no shell, so no `&&`, no quoting, and no way to write a
step whose failure is swallowed by a `|| true` nobody notices.
`outcomes` (DR-7, task 078) maps a step's non-zero exit codes to the verdict
the step actually computed. Without it every non-zero code is a failure and
exit 0 is a pass — which is right until a gate has a THIRD answer. Exit 0 is
not declarable, `advisory` requires an issue and an expiry, and an expired
advisory fails. A step may not rename its own pass.

steps.why: DR-12 rehydration prefix fingerprint — the assembled prefix may not drift silently.
DR-13 rehydration prose lint — slop may not re-enter the assembled context.
#1342 — event-store access goes through the composition root, not ad-hoc opens.
#1556 — migrateEvents stays the single read-seam upcast choke point.
#1504 — no raw .state.json read/write in production; SQLite is the source of truth.
#1554 — one canonical workflow-state reducer, not a second fold that can disagree.
v2.12 DR-5 — every proof-substrate finding has an exact typed owner.

DR-27 — every annotated numeric claim in the wave spec is re-derived from the artifact that produces it. Exits 3 with `VERDICT: GAPS` while rungs are unprobed; that is a reportable gap, not a failure.

3.why: Unprobed obligation rungs (11 of 13 at task 078). The gate used to exit 0 here, so this aggregate recorded `PASS measured-premises` for a step that printed `VERDICT: GAPS` — DR-7's exact shape. The gaps are real work, not a defect in the gate, so the step is tolerated rather than red; the toleration is dated and tracked so it cannot quietly become permanent. Probing the rungs deletes this block.
